instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign GeoBranchGate.jsx to match the user choices and mockup description EXACTLY. Ensure the selected card has the cream-to-gold gradient fill, dark text, gold border glow, service chips, thumbnail with badge pill, and handwritten script accent. Ensure the dark card has glassmorphic styling and correct chips/accent. Ensure all data-testids, geolocation logic, and picking behavior are fully preserved.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements and status indicators MUST maintain exact data-testids.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Playfair Display for headers, Outfit for body text, and Caveat for handwritten script accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_palette: Strictly stick to black #0b0a0c, gold #e8c97a / #d4af37, cream #fff4d6.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive: On screens smaller than 640px, stack elements nicely and ensure thumbnails shrink or adapt gracefully while keeping cards luxurious.
